1.why: Original is a comma splice of two independent clauses; semicolon fixes it, B makes a causally odd claim.

2.why: every question, every answer, every objection is already parallel; all alternatives break the pattern.

3.why: Series drop / push / swing requires a bare verb parallel with the first two.

4.why: each ring angled... is an absolute phrase with no finite verb, so comma is correct; semicolon/period would leave a fragment.

5.why: Historical aside is the standard irrelevant-addition shape; A names a specific explanatory focus (conduction/convection) the aside would interrupt.
